case_name: John Vallamattom And Anr. vs Union Of India (Uoi)

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: John Vallamattom And Anr., Christian Priest and member of the Christian community

facts_of_case: Petitioners are aggrieved by discriminatory treatment meted out to members of the Christian community under the Indian Succession Act, 1925. They were practically prevented from bequeathing property for religious and charitable purposes.

legal_principles.principle: The forceability of pre-constitution laws is subject to the provisions of the Constitution and until they are altered, repealed or amended by a competent legislature or other competent authorities.
legal_principles.held: forceability of pre-constitution laws subject of course to the provisions of the Constitution and until they are altered, repealed or amended by a competent legislature or other competent authorities.

legal_principles.principle: The equality clause enshrined in Article 14 of the Constitution guarantees equality before the law or the equal protection of the laws within the territory of India.
legal_principles.held: The equality clause enshrined in Article 14 of the Constitution is of wide import. It guarantees equality before the law or the equal protection of the laws within the territory of India.

legal_principles.principle: A reasonable classification based on intelligible differentia having nexus with the object sought to be achieved can be upheld.
legal_principles.held: The restriction imposed by reason of a statute, however, can be upheld in the event it be held that the person to whom the same applies, forms a separate and distinct class and such classification is a reasonable one based on intelligible differentia having nexus with the object sought to be achieved.

legal_principles.principle: A person has the right to dispose of his property by Will, unless restricted by law.
legal_principles.held: The concept of ownership of a person over a property or a right although is a varying one includes right to dispose of his property by Will.

use_for_drafting: drafting a will for Christian community members
challenging discriminatory treatment in succession laws
